risk.screen.description: Screen one Hedera account against the private risk feed

c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3.does: Watches two accounts and reports which is riskier. Cannot spend much.

9de980aa335df2af27ea4c640c09878ca7d9dd91.does: Runs on a GitHub runner — hardware nobody here owns. Buys one inference, then asks for too much.
